title: 横管上装

geometry.name: Bray-reference generic DN25 ball valve
geometry.reference_product: Bray Flow-Tek 7000 series / 7100 threaded full-port, RPTFE seats
geometry.safety_trigger_state: fixed unlocked / manufacturer-described bypass; trigger action omitted

provenance.catalogue_dimensions: Bray 7000/8000 brochure, page 10, DN25: A=92 mm for NPT/SW/BW, D=200 mm shaft-to-handle-end, C=87 mm pipe-axis-to-highest-point, C1=52 mm pipe-axis-to-mounting-top. Visual PDF dimension lines verified. H/J=35.7 mm are mounting hole spacings, not heights.
provenance.contact_shape_reference: User-approved 2026-10-21 generic bent flat metal lever with thin blue cover. It stays flat through the tip, without QH enlarged block/cylinder. Width 20 mm, covered total thickness 6 mm, metal plate 3 mm and bend positions are task assumptions, not Bray measurements.
provenance.assumptions: Body radii, rounded bolt envelopes, detailed cast shape, covered grip cross-section, bend location, moving mass/inertia and contact friction are simplified task settings. Simplified exterior only; internal ball, seals, threads, fluid and pressure omitted. Safety trigger held in the manufacturer-described bypass state; unlocking not part of this task.

resistance_provenance.magnitude_source: Bray TB1005, page 3: DN25 full-port two-way ball valve with RPTFE seats, 0 bar line pressure, basic torque 14 N*m. Used as the task breakaway reference for the Bray Flow-Tek 7000/7100 dimension-reference valve. This is manufacturer actuator-sizing guidance, not a direct measurement of our valve or a universal DN25 standard value; application and operation-frequency factors may change real requirements.
resistance_provenance.shape_source: Bray TB1005, page 11: typical floating-ball valve curve in both opening and closing directions, break torque 100%, running approximately 75%, ending approximately 90%. MSS SP-91-2025 provides broader qualitative guidance; it does not specify a universal DN25 torque.
resistance_provenance.shape_assumptions: The model uses the manufacturer typical 100/75/90 percent ratios in both directions. Smooth initial transitions span 15% of travel and end rises span 22%; these transition positions, interpolation, static re-entry and friction hysteresis are task assumptions, not digitized or individually measured Bray curves. With scale=1, nominal break/run/end levels are 14/10.5/12.6 N*m.

allowed_base_region_world.interpretation: Allowed fixed-base reference position only; the submitted physical geometry must also remain collision-free.
